description: A Kotlin class implementing a dialog fragment for voice and text search of workouts in a fitness app. It includes UI setup, speech recognition integration, and interaction with a mock data repository.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment providing voice and text search capabilities for workouts within the app.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and sets up the dialog UI with search and microphone buttons, initializing the adapter and its update logic.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the speech recognition activity, updating the search input field with recognized speech.
